info.title: xaflogic
info.description: Command-line tool that extracts functional documentation from DevExpress XAF projects using Roslyn, and makes it available to AI coding agents. Reads entities, controllers, actions, module setup, navigation and Model Editor (.xafml) customizations from source -- no compilation of the target project, no DevExpress reference required. Supports XPO and EF Core, incremental change detection, and multi-project solutions.
